deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
No upstream method signature changes, so the main work is ensuring the monkey-patched classes keep the new state consistent rather than re-implementing it.
1) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_mamba_manager.py: AscendMambaManager intentionally does not override __init__ and must keep it that way; it now inherits _tips/_req_hit/_req_tip from MambaManager.__init__, plus add_local_computed_blocks, cache_blocks_on_free, _record_tip, _deprioritize_superseded_state and reset_prefix_cache. If a future Ascend override of __init__ is added, it must call super().__init__ so these dicts exist; do not duplicate the old cache_blocks_on_free body (the new body now also records tips and deprioritizes).
2) vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py: AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator must NOT override reset_prefix_cache (it currently does not) so the new KVCacheCoordinator.reset_prefix_cache clears each Mamba manager's _tips. Keep its custom __init__ setting manager.cache_hit_alignment_tokens before any request free, because _deprioritize_superseded_state reads self.cache_hit_alignment_tokens to compute the junction hash index; ensure single_type_managers remains populated as a sequence for the reset loop. Verify read/reconcile paths (find_longest_cache_hit, find_longest_cache_hit_per_group, skips_eagle_block_drop, partial-hash-hit alignment) still return the same hit lengths after the new eviction ordering.
3) vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_pool/kv_offload/preempt_offload/manager.py:686 reset_cache currently resets only self.cpu_block_pool.reset_prefix_cache(). Change it to self.cpu_coordinator.reset_prefix_cache() (guarding has_pending_transfers as today) so any Mamba manager-level _tips/_req_hit/_req_tip in the CPU coordinator are cleared together with the pool; otherwise a future use of the CPU coordinator's cache_blocks/cache_blocks_on_free can leave stale tip hashes after a reset.
4) AscendCircularBufferManager and glm5next KpoolTailManager need no code change (they inherit the new no-op SingleTypeKVCacheManager.reset_prefix_cache; KpoolTailManager disables caching).
5) Add/extend unit tests: in tests/ut/patch/platform/test_prefix_cache_cp_patches.py and test_patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py assert that AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.reset_prefix_cache() returns True and clears AscendMambaManager._tips/_req_hit/_req_tip; add a mamba-align multi-turn hit regression under deprioritization. Keep existing PD producer-drop / partial-tail / boundary-offload tests passing.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium-low. The change is inheritance-compatible and bounds-checks the junction index, so no crash or signature break is expected. The real risk is behavioral: the new three-tier eviction (uncached -> deprioritized FIFO -> normal LRU) changes which Mamba state pages survive under memory pressure. vllm-ascend has custom hybrid Mamba/PD prefix-cache tuning (patch_kv_cache_coordinator producer drop exemption, patch_mamba_block_aligned_split chunk-boundary handling, partial-tail/boundary-state offload) that assumes specific boundary states stay cached; if a state it relies on is now deprioritized, hybrid prefix-cache hit rates or PD resume correctness can regress without an exception. Ascend's custom cache_hit_alignment_tokens (lcm with tail_pool_alignment) may differ from upstream and affects which predecessor hash is deprioritized, so validate mamba-align multi-turn and PD (producer/consumer) scenarios on NPU.

commits.comment: 新增 `/health_generate` 生成就绪探针，贯穿 EngineClient→AsyncLLM→EngineCoreClient→EngineCoreProc→Executor→Worker。设计要点：空闲 EngineCore 执行一次 dummy forward（`Executor.probe_forward` 对所有 rank collective_rpc 并等待，覆盖 PP 非输出 stage 独立失败；`DPEngineCoreProc._probe_forward` 只做存活检查，避免 wave 外 dummy batch 与 peer 的 collective 死锁），busy 时返回 BUSY 不增加 GPU 工作，sleeping/paused 返回 SLEEPING；AsyncLLM 用 `_health_probe_tasks` 共享 in-flight probe（超时请求不取消 probe，后续 caller 复用），聚合出 `sleeping`/`probe_timeout`/`probe_failed` 并抛 `EngineSleepingError`/`EngineUnhealthyError`，健康端点返回结构化 503 JSON。Worker 侧新增 `WorkerBase.probe_forward()`（默认返回错误字符串而非抛异常，保证 executor 读到每个 worker 回复、collective 队列不错位）和 GPU Worker 实现（`_dummy_run(decode_query_len, uniform_decode=True, num_active_loras=0)` + synchronize，失败时恢复 `kv_connector.set_disabled(False)`，不污染 iteration timer）。风险：新端点免鉴权且会触发 GPU 工作（文档已说明并建议只用于 readiness）；probe 依赖 model_runner 的 `_dummy_run` 签名与 `kv_connector` 属性；metrics 已排除该路径。整体为 additive 接口，但触达 worker/executor/engine 核心。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Add an Ascend-specific `probe_forward(self) -> str | None` override to `vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py::NPUWorker` instead of relying on the inherited `GPUWorker.probe_forward`. Mirror `NPUWorker.execute_dummy_batch`: run `self.model_runner._dummy_run(self.model_runner.decode_query_len, uniform_decode=True, skip_gdn_state_update=True, num_active_loras=0)` inside `with set_current_vllm_config(self.vllm_config):`, then `self.synchronize_device()` (which already maps to `torch.npu.synchronize()`). The `set_current_vllm_config` scope is required on Ascend for ACL-graph/replay metadata (same reason as `execute_dummy_batch`), and `skip_gdn_state_update=True` is required so the idle probe does not mutate DeepSeek V4.1 GDN/compressor ring state. Return `repr(e)` on failure rather than raising (the upstream executor expects one result per rank and keeps reply queues aligned); on failure also restore `self.model_runner.kv_connector.set_disabled(False)` and any Ascend-side payload state touched by `_dummy_run` (EPLB dump/step, KVPP/KV-offload dummy bookkeeping). Consider applying the same idle-wave guard used by `execute_dummy_batch` (`vllm_ascend/observability/runtime_guard/hooks.py::runtime_guard_idle_step`) if the probe can run on a DP rank; otherwise confirm the inherited `DPEngineCoreProc._probe_forward` no-op remains in effect for `BalanceDPEngineCoreProc` / `DyntraLBDPEngineCoreProc` so no dummy batch runs outside the DP wave. No change should be needed in `NPUModelRunner._dummy_run` itself (it already consumes `skip_gdn_state_update` and forwards `num_active_loras` via `**kwargs`), in `XliteModelRunner._dummy_run` (uniform_decode already routes through `dummy_batch`), or in `NPUModelRunner310V2` (inherits the override). Add Ascend unit tests analogous to `tests/ut/worker/test_idle_dummy_config.py`, asserting that `probe_forward` scopes `vllm_config`, passes `skip_gdn_state_update=True`, calls `synchronize_device`, returns errors instead of raising, and leaves the KV connector enabled; add multi-rank (PP/TP and DP) readiness coverage mirroring upstream `tests/entrypoints/serve/instrumentator/readiness/`.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. The inherited probe compiles/runs with the wrong runtime context on Ascend: without `set_current_vllm_config` it can use stale ACL-graph/replay metadata, and without `skip_gdn_state_update` it can update DeepSeek V4.1 compressor/GDN ring state during an idle health check, causing incorrect outputs or hangs on the next real request. Because the probe runs a real dummy forward on every idle rank, PP/EPLB/KVPP collectives can mismatch or time out, producing false 503s on healthy engines; DP ranks are intentionally not probed upstream, so `/health_generate` may only prove liveness for Ascend DP deployments.

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/ascend_config.py::AscendConfig (pydantic dataclass with ConfigDict(extra="forbid"), so an unknown kda_prefill_conv key raises ValidationError)
recipes/overlays/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash.yaml (extracted upstream recipe overlay; may need regeneration so docs do not publish a key that Ascend rejects)

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
The commit itself is a CUDA/SM10x-only perf change. vllm-ascend does not use vllm/models/glm5next/common/kda.py at all: vllm_ascend/models/__init__.py maps Glm5NextForCausalLM/Glm5NextMTPModel to vllm_ascend.models.glm5next.model/mtp, whose Glm5NextLinearAttention subclasses GatedDeltaNetAttention and runs its own NPU causal_conv1d + chunk_kda (vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/ops/causal_conv1d.py, ops/kda.py). Therefore the new common/kda.py _resolve_kda_prefill_conv/_prefill_conv/causal_conv1d_planar code and the new nvidia kda_prefill_conv.py Triton kernels never execute on Ascend and need no kernel port.

However, the commit introduces a new user-facing additional_config option, kda_prefill_conv ("auto"|"causal_conv1d"|"planar"), documented in vllm's recipes/models/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash.yaml as `--additional-config '{"kda_prefill_conv":"causal_conv1d"}'`. In vllm_ascend/ascend_config.py::init_ascend_config, additional_config keys outside AscendConfig.__dataclass_fields__ are passed to AscendConfig(extra="forbid") and raise a validation error. So a user following the upstream GLM-5.3-Flash recipe on Ascend will fail at startup.

Required changes:
1) In init_ascend_config(), add "kda_prefill_conv" to _NON_USER_INPUT_KEYS (next to gdn_prefill_backend/kda_prefill_backend) so it is stripped before pydantic validation.
2) Optionally extend the _prefill_key warning loop (or add an analogous loop) so that kda_prefill_conv values "planar" and "causal_conv1d" emit warning_once that only the Ascend Triton conv path is available and the option is ignored; strip "auto" silently, matching existing kda_prefill_backend behavior. On Ascend the key is purely inert because the ascend KDA layer uses its own conv implementation.
3) Add a unit test in tests/ut/test_ascend_config.py (same _clean_up_ascend_config / patched logger pattern) asserting that additional_config={"kda_prefill_conv": "planar"} does not raise, is stripped, and warns; and that "auto" is silent.
4) If the recipes/overlays are auto-generated from upstream, refresh recipes/overlays/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash.yaml so it does not advertise the CUDA-only option for Ascend hardware.

No change is needed in vllm_ascend/models/glm5next/kda.py for correctness; implementing a planar/tiled short conv on NPU would be an independent optional optimization, not part of this adaptation.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. Without the config-strip change, the only failure mode is a startup pydantic ValidationError when a user explicitly passes kda_prefill_conv via --additional-config (the option is not injected by EngineArgs, so default runs are unaffected). Ascend runtime correctness and performance of GLM-5.3-Flash KDA are unchanged because Ascend's own Glm5NextLinearAttention and NPU conv/chunk kernels remain the execution path; the upstream planar kernel is never selected because current_platform is not CUDA.
